description.en: Built-in language packs for the OpenDesk main UI and applications: German (de-DE), French (fr-FR), Indonesian (id-ID), Russian (ru-RU) and Turkish (tr-TR). Locale packs built on the resources.locales contract; untranslated keys fall back to English.
description.zh: OpenDesk 主界面与各应用的内置语言包：德语（de-DE）、法语（fr-FR）、印尼语（id-ID）、俄语（ru-RU）与土耳其语（tr-TR）。基于 resources.locales 契约，未翻译的 key 回退英文。
